items.title: 6 things investors need to watch in the week ahead
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host, Josh Lipton, tees up the key events investors should watch in the week ahead, starting Monday, August 31, with earnings from Dell (DELL), Palo Alto Networks (PANW), Lululemon (LULU), and Snowflake. (SNOW) On Wednesday, Broadcom's (AVGO) results will offer another read on the AI trade. Then on Friday, investors will get the August jobs report, with economists expecting the unemployment rate to hold steady at 4.1%

items.title: Can Salesforce (CRM) Still Look Reasonable After AI Driven Gains?
items.summary: Salesforce stock has surged over the past month, yet several valuation checks still point to room between the current share price and an intrinsic value estimate based on Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) and market multiples. With both approaches flagging the stock as undervalued, investors are weighing how much of the recent excitement around Salesforce and its AI products is already reflected in the price. items.title: Salesforce Just Jumped 23%. Did the “SaaSpocalypse” Trade Finally Break?
items.summary: Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE:CRM) jumped 22.6% on August 27 after earnings, and the move did more than rescue one software stock.
